The '''Magic Cowboy Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Desert Trader]] on odd-numbered calendar days for 333 [[Omni Geode]]s.  It changes color, cycling through the colors of a [[Prismatic Shard]].
